for a Manhattan-bound 6.

Then either:

Or,

and E 149 St. Transfer to a Botanical Garden-bound Bx19 to Southern Boulevard at 
Hunts Pt Av.

equipment.alternativeroute:
For B, D, F, M, use ramps to access uptown A, C, E platform.
Use the elevator to transfer to an uptown B,D,F, or M to 34 St-Herald Sq. For downtown B, D, F, M, use the elevators at 34 St-Herald Sq to transfer to downtown service. For downtown B, D, F, M, take an uptown B, D, F, M to 34 St-Herald Sq and use elevators to transfer to a downtown B, D, F, M.
For downtown A, C, or E, take an uptown A,C, or E to 14 St and use elevators to transfer to a downtown A, C, or E. To exit the station, take a downtown B,D,F, or M to B’way-Lafayette St. Then use elevators and transfer to uptown B,D,F, or M to W 4 St, or exit the B’way-Lafayette St station and take a westbound M21 bus (Houston St and Crosby St) to Houston St and 6 Av. Transfer to an uptown M55 bus to 3 St and 6 Av.
For the A or C, take a downtown F to Jay St-MetroTech and transfer across the platform for Brooklyn-bound service.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: 149 St Complex & Tremont Av
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making the 149 St Grand Concourse complex and Tremont Av BD stations accessible and improving the station environments. At 149 St Grand Concourse, we will construct new customer circulation areas, make critical state of good repair upgrades, and add new elevators and digital customer information screens. At Tremont Av, we will install new elevators, reconstruct staircases, and renew platform edges. Together, these projects will make these stations fully accessible.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements and Renewal: Borough Hall
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making this station accessible and improving the station environment. This project will fully renew the Borough Hall 4/5 station and make it fully accessible. We will add 3 new elevators, widen and upgrade staircases, and reconfigure parts of the station to accommodate the new accessible features. As part of the renewal work, we will replace platform edges and wall tiles, repair steel beams and girders that keep the station safe and waterproof the station roof.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: Broadway Junction
projects.description: We are making crucial investments to improve accessibility, circulation, and design at Broadway Junction, Brooklyn's third largest subway station. We’re adding 7 new elevators, a new entrance on Van Sinderen Avenue, refinishing platforms, and improving the passageways that connect the station.  ADA accessibility at Broadway Junction will be transformative for the public realm around the station. ADA accessibility at Broadway Junction will be transformative for the public realm around the station. Read more about this project at mta.info/project/investing-Broadway-junction

projects.title: MNR ADA Station Improvements: Woodlawn, Botanic Garden, Williams Bridge
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making the Botanical Gardens, Williams Bridge, and Woodlawn Metro-North stations accessible and improving the station environment. We will completely rebuild the Williams Bridge and Woodlawn stations and make them accessible with new elevators at each platform. The Botanical Garden station will receive new elevators, structural repairs, new platform features, and a rehabilitation of the historic station canopy, among other improvements.

projects.title: NYCT ADA: Package 1
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we delivered 17 new elevators across eight stations—7 Av (Brooklyn), Grand St (L), Metropolitan Av (G), Lorimer St (L), E 149 St (Bronx), Dyckman St (1), Beach 67 St (A), and New Dorp (SIR). The work created street-to-platform accessible paths and included platform, fare control, and communications upgrades.

projects.title: NYCT ADA: Package 2
projects.description: We made six stations newly accessible—Westchester Sq–E Tremont Av, 181 St, Queensboro Plaza, 8 Av, Court Sq, and Woodhaven Blvd—and replaced elevators at Marcy Av and Flushing Av. The package delivered 11 new elevators, five replacements, ADA fare gates, platform-edge/tactile upgrades, and state-of-good-repair work.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: Package 4
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making the Bay Ridge-95 St R, 137 St City College 1, Northern Blvd MR, and Parkchester 6 subway stations accessible and improving the station environment. This project will make all four stations newly accessible with new elevators, wider staircases, and new ADA-compliant boarding areas, in addition to making critical state of good repair improvements.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: Package 3
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making accessibility improvements at 13 stations. This project includes eight stations being made newly accessible and five stations receiving elevator replacements with more modern, reliable units. We are also making structural, architectural, and electrical improvements that make way for these new elements and allow them to function safely and reliably.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: Package 5
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making 13 stations accessible. This project will add new elevators or ADA accessible ramps to stations across New York City. In addition, we are making structural improvements to the stations, improving electrical and communications equipment, and restoring adjacent streets and sidewalks.

projects.title: ADA / Station Renewals: Brook Av & 3 Av-138 St / PEL
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making 3 Av–138 St and Brook Av (6) accessible and renewing both stations with new ADA boarding areas, upgraded platform edges, new lighting, and improvements to other station infrastructure.

projects.title: LIRR ADA Station Improvements: Package 1
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making improvements at 9 LIRR stations. This project includes making 7 stations newly accessible and replacing elevators and escalators at 2 additional stations. In addition to adding new elevators and their supporting infrastructure, we will repair platforms and canopies, add new lighting, and replace digital customer communications systems, among other structural improvements.

projects.title: LIRR ADA Station Improvements: Package 2
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making improvements at the Forest Hills, Hollis, and Babylon LIRR stations. In addition to making these stations fully accessible, we are undertaking a major station renovation at Babylon and state of good repair improvements at Forest Hills and Hollis.

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: Package 6
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making five stations accessible—Norwood Av (J/Z), Myrtle Av (J/M/Z), Avenue I (F), Burnside Av (4), and Middletown Rd (6)—and improving the station environment. This package adds new elevators and accessible paths, upgrades stairs and fare payment areas, and delivers state of good repair work like platform and structural fixes so these stations are safer, more reliable, and easier to use for everyone.

projects.title: NYCT ADA: Package 7
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making the 167 St B/D and Kingsbridge Rd 4 stations accessible. This project will add new elevators, relocate staircases, and create new ADA-compliant boarding areas. In addition, we are making structural improvements to the stations, improving electrical and communications equipment, and restoring adjacent streets and sidewalks.

projects.title: Design-Build Services for ADA Upgrades Package 8
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making five stations accessible - 18 Av (D), Fort Hamilton Pkwy (D), Jefferson St (L), Neptune Av (F), and Nostrand Av (A,C).

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: Package 9
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making the Parsons Blvd F, Briarwood E/F, and Gates Av J/Z subway stations accessible and improving the station environment. This project will make all three stations newly accessible with new elevators, wider staircases, and new ADA-compliant boarding areas, in addition to making critical state of good repair improvements.

projects.title: Design-Build Services for ADA Upgrades - Package 10
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making three stations accessible - 2 Av (F), 7 Av (B,D,E), and Morrison Av-Soundview (6).

projects.title: Design-Build Services for ADA Upgrades Package 11
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making three stations accessible - 110 St (6), 145 St (A,B,C,D), and Wakefield-241 St (2).

projects.title: NYCT ADA Station Improvements: 42 St - Bryant Park Complex
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making the Bryant Park-5 Av subway station complex accessible and improving the station environment. This project will make both the Bryant Park-42 St B/D/F/M and 5 Av 7 stations newly accessible with new elevators, wider staircases, and new ADA-compliant boarding areas, in addition to making critical state of good repair improvements.

projects.title: ADA Station Improvements - Package 3
projects.description: As part of the MTA’s commitment to systemwide accessibility, we are making LIRR Bellerose and Floral Park stations accessible and making significant station improvements.

projects.title: 25-29 NYCT ADA Improvements (incl. SIR)
projects.description: The MTA is committed to improving transit access for everyone, including customers with disabilities, people traveling with children in strollers, seniors, and more. The 2025-2029 Capital Plan continues the MTA's commitment to make the system more accessible, with at least 60 more subway stations slated for ADA improvements. With these investments, approximately 70% of all subway rides will take place to or from accessible stations – and we’ll stay on track to make 95% of subway stations accessible by 2055. This page represents candidate locations identified in the 2025-2029 Capital Plan and is not a comprehensive list of locations within this element. As projects are developed and awarded, locations may change and additional locations may be identified.

projects.title: 25-29 MNR ADA
projects.description: The MTA is committed to improving transit access for everyone, including customers with disabilities, people traveling with children in strollers, seniors, and more. With the 2025-2029 Capital Plan, Metro-North will continue to add elevators, ramps, and create accessible routes between platforms to make full-service stations in Metro-North-operated territory fully accessible, where feasible. This page represents candidate locations identified in the 2025-2029 Capital Plan and is not a comprehensive list of locations within this element. As projects are developed and awarded, locations may change and additional locations may be identified.
